newsitem.title: JAPAN: JNR Corp land sales results due at 0730 GMT.
newsitem.headline: JNR Corp land sales results due at 0730 GMT.

text.p: The results of land sales by JNR Settlement Corp will be announced at 4.30 p.m. (0730 GMT) by the Ministry of Transport, a spokesman for the body said on Monday.
The auction will close at 12.30 p.m. (0330 GMT), he said.

Monday's auction will cover some 53,000 sq metres of idle land in the Minato district of Tokyo, which was once used as a freight station and switching yard for the now-defunct Japanese National Railways.
A total of 64 companies from 14 consortiums registered last August as bidders in the land auction.
